description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC Controller named ProfesorController for managing 'Profesor' entities. It handles HTTP requests related to creating, reading, updating, deleting, and viewing details of professors, including role-based access control annotations. The controller interacts with service and repository layers and maps requests to specific view templates.

classes.name: ProfesorController
classes.description: A Spring MVC Controller for handling HTTP requests related to 'Profesor' entities including CRUD operations and detailed views with role-based authorization.

methods.name: addProfesor

methods.name: saveProfesor
methods.description: Saves a new Profesor entity provided via form submission.

methods.name: getProfesorForUpdate
methods.description: Retrieves an existing Profesor by ID for editing.

methods.name: updateProfesor
methods.description: Updates an existing Profesor entity with new data.

methods.description: Retrieves and displays a list of all Profesors.

methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific Profesor, including associated Cursos.
